# Biteperk

> Biteperk builds voice and AI tools for Australian hospitality. Our flagship product, VocoTable, is an AI phone host ("Bella") that answers every restaurant call in a warm Australian voice, checks live availability, and books the table 24/7 — so venues never lose a booking to a phone nobody can answer. Built, hosted and supported in Sydney; serving restaurants, cafés and venues Australia-wide.

## Key facts

- Company: Biteperk Pty Ltd, a Sydney-based voice/AI software company for hospitality.
- Location: Level 1, 477 Pitt Street, Haymarket NSW 2000, Australia (serves all of Australia).
- Contact: phone 0450 011 140 (+61 450 011 140); email hello@biteperk.com.au; hours Mon–Fri 9am–5pm AEST.
- Flagship product: VocoTable — live and serving paying customers.
- VocoTable pricing (AUD, flat monthly, no per-call or per-cover fees): Solo $80/month (up to 300 covers, 1 venue), Pro $150/month (unlimited covers — "Our pick"), Group $250/month (up to 3 venues), Enterprise custom (4+ venues). Free week trial; month-to-month, no lock-in.
- Setup: works with a venue's existing phone number — just forward calls. No new hardware, no installation, no IT. Most venues are live the same day.
- The AI voice ("Bella") speaks natural Australian English and gets local suburb/street names right — not an overseas call centre.
- Data/privacy: Australian data residency; Privacy Act compliant; call audio stays in-house and is not sold. (See the privacy policy for specifics.)

## Products

- [VocoTable](https://biteperk.com.au/products/vocotable/): **Live.** The AI phone host for restaurants. "Bella" answers every call on the first ring, 24/7, handles the booking conversation, and writes reservations straight into the venue's diary against real availability (no double-bookings). Pricing: Solo $80 / Pro $150 / Group $250 per month / Enterprise custom — flat, no per-call or per-cover fees, free week trial.
- [VocoOrder](https://biteperk.com.au/products/vocoorder/): **In development.** AI phone ordering for takeaway and pickup — a voice agent that handles the order, the modifiers, and the pickup time, then sends a clean ticket to the POS. Waitlist open.
- [VocoConcierge](https://biteperk.com.au/products/vococoncierge/): **In development.** Voice + SMS front-of-house concierge — nudges the waitlist, confirms upcoming covers, recovers no-shows, and replies when guests text back. Waitlist open.
- [VocoDrive](https://biteperk.com.au/products/vocodrive/): **Concept.** A voice agent for the drive-through window, built around how an Australian queue actually moves. Register interest.
- [All products](https://biteperk.com.au/products/): The full Biteperk catalogue with the current status of each product.

- [Why an Australian voice matters on your restaurant's phone](https://biteperk.com.au/blog/why-an-australian-voice-matters/): Why a genuinely local voice — accent, place names, data — changes how guests feel about a venue.

- [AI receptionist vs answering service vs voicemail](https://biteperk.com.au/blog/ai-receptionist-vs-answering-service-vs-voicemail/): A clear comparison of the ways restaurants handle phone calls and which fits which venue.
